content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 6.1 is an exclusivity obligation binding us (The Deerskin Companies) — a term-long ban on participating in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products *and* substantially similar products, plus HDI's exclusive right to our own "Deerskin" brand for direct-to-consumer web sales. Because the Section 4.1 term auto-renews annually and there is no automatic exit for HDI performance failures, the clause fails the fallback on scope, duration and exit, and approaches walk-away territory.

**Redline (fallback target, single surgical replace):** exclusivity confined to Deerskin Products, capped at twelve (12) months from the Effective Date, terminating automatically if HDI misses any service level or delivery date. Section 6.2's closeout carve-out and HDI's reciprocal non-compete in Section 6.3 (which benefits us) are preserved verbatim.
